issues.display_title: Issue #525: Refactor Users Module Password and Account Linking Flows
issues.main_description_html:
Implementation: Refactor Users Module Password and Account Linking Flows

Summary

Refactored src/Action/V1/Users/ password flows (ResetPassword, UpdatePassword) and social account management (AddAccount, UnlinkAccount) by extracting shared validation, token expiration checks, and account linking updates into account_helpers.go. Replaced manual Apple JWK decoding in AddAccount.go with RegisterFunctions.VerifyAppleToken, and added a unit test suite in account_helpers_test.go.

Files Updated

1. src/Action/V1/Users/account_helpers.go

  • ValidatePasswordLength(password string, minLength int) bool: Checks password length constraint.
  • VerifyOldPassword(oldPasswordInput, currentHashedPassword string) bool: Compares MD5 of old password with stored hash.
  • IsTokenExpired(expVal interface{}, now time.Time) bool: Checks token expiration timestamp from context locals safely.
  • IsValidSocialProvider(provider string) bool: Checks if provider is google, facebook, or apple.
  • IsSocialAccountLinked(provider string, ua Models.UserAccount) bool: Checks whether the specified provider is linked on the account.
  • BuildUnlinkAccountUpdates(provider string) map[string]interface{}: Prepares unlinking update map setting provider fields to nil.
  • BuildGoogleAccountUpdates(emailGoogle string) (map[string]interface{}, string): Prepares Google linking update map and extracted Google ID.
  • BuildAppleAccountUpdates(emailApple, currentEmail string) (map[string]interface{}, string): Prepares Apple linking update map and extracted Apple ID.

2. src/Action/V1/Users/account_helpers_test.go

  • Added 8 unit tests covering:
    • TestValidatePasswordLength: Checks length validations.
    • TestVerifyOldPassword: Checks matching, mismatching, and empty inputs.
    • TestIsTokenExpired: Checks past, future, nil, and invalid types.
    • TestIsValidSocialProvider: Checks supported and unsupported providers.
    • TestIsSocialAccountLinked: Checks linked status for google, facebook, and apple.
    • TestBuildUnlinkAccountUpdates: Checks update fields set to nil per provider.
    • TestBuildGoogleAccountUpdates: Checks google_id and google_email values.
    • TestBuildAppleAccountUpdates: Checks apple_id and apple_email values.

3. Handlers in src/Action/V1/Users/

  • ResetPassword.go:
    • Replaced inline expiration check with IsTokenExpired.
    • Replaced inline password length check with ValidatePasswordLength.
    • Safe type assertions on Fiber locals (role, exp, encrypt).
  • UpdatePassword.go:
    • Replaced inline password length checks with ValidatePasswordLength.
    • Replaced inline old password verification with VerifyOldPassword.
    • Safe type assertions on Fiber locals.
  • AddAccount.go:
    • Replaced provider checks with IsValidSocialProvider.
    • Replaced ~80 lines of manual Apple JWK decoding with RegisterFunctions.VerifyAppleToken.
    • Replaced Google/Apple update map generation with BuildGoogleAccountUpdates and BuildAppleAccountUpdates.
    • Safe type assertions on Fiber locals (role, userId, encrypt).
  • UnlinkAccount.go:
    • Replaced provider check with IsValidSocialProvider.
    • Replaced inline linked check with IsSocialAccountLinked.
    • Replaced manual unlinking map construction with BuildUnlinkAccountUpdates.
    • Safe type assertions on Fiber locals.

Verification

go test -v ./src/Action/V1/Users/...
go vet ./src/Action/V1/Users
go test ./...
  • All 18 unit tests in src/Action/V1/Users passed.
  • go vet reported zero issues.
  • Entire project test suite across all packages passed cleanly.

Problem

The account and password management handlers in src/Action/V1/Users/ (ResetPassword.go, UpdatePassword.go, AddAccount.go, and UnlinkAccount.go) exhibited several maintainability and safety issues:

  1. Unsafe Type Assertions: Direct casting on context locals (role, userId, encrypt) risked runtime panics if fields were nil or invalid.
  2. Duplicated Password Validation: Password length checks and old password hash verification logic were repeated.
  3. Redundant Apple JWK Decoding: AddAccount.go contained ~80 lines of manual HTTP fetching, JWK key parsing, and JWT header/payload decoding that duplicated the battle-tested RegisterFunctions.VerifyAppleToken.
  4. Scattered Provider Logic: Validation of supported social providers (google, facebook, apple) and preparation of database update maps were implemented inline.

Scope

  • Create src/Action/V1/Users/account_helpers.go:
    • ValidatePasswordLength: Validates password meets minimum length.
    • VerifyOldPassword: Verifies MD5 password match.
    • IsTokenExpired: Validates token expiration timestamp safely.
    • IsValidSocialProvider: Validates supported social login providers.
    • IsSocialAccountLinked: Checks whether a provider is linked on a Models.UserAccount.
    • BuildUnlinkAccountUpdates: Generates nil update maps for unlinking providers.
    • BuildGoogleAccountUpdates: Generates Google linking database updates.
    • BuildAppleAccountUpdates: Generates Apple linking database updates.
  • Refactor ResetPassword.go, UpdatePassword.go, AddAccount.go, and UnlinkAccount.go to use account_helpers.go and RegisterFunctions.VerifyAppleToken.
  • Add unit tests in src/Action/V1/Users/account_helpers_test.go.

Behavior Boundary

  • 100% backward compatible: No changes to endpoint contracts, request payloads, response payloads, or error message strings.

Acceptance Criteria

  • account_helpers.go implemented and used across password and account linking handlers.
  • account_helpers_test.go implemented with comprehensive unit tests.
  • All unit tests in src/Action/V1/Users pass (go test -v ./src/Action/V1/Users).
  • go vet ./src/Action/V1/Users reports zero issues.
  • Entire project test suite passes (go test ./...).

Delivery

Implemented in the working tree on 2026-10-01.

issues.display_title: Issue #526: Refactor Posts Module Engagement and Visibility Flows
issues.main_description_html:
Implementation: Refactor Posts Module Engagement and Visibility Flows

Summary

Refactored src/Action/V1/Posts/ engagement and visibility operations (InsertViewPost, InsertSharePost, UpdateScore, BlockPost, and CheckPost) by extracting shared visibility checks, query identifier resolvers, IP validation, and model/response builders into engagement_helpers.go. Integrated the helpers across the handlers with panic-safe Fiber context assertions and established a unit test suite in engagement_helpers_test.go.

Files Updated

1. src/Action/V1/Posts/engagement_helpers.go

  • IsPrivatePost(visibility *string) bool: Checks if post visibility pointer is "private".
  • IsValidIP(ip string) bool: Validates IPv4 and IPv6 string formats.
  • IsValidScoreAction(action string) bool: Validates whether score action is one of view, like, comment, or suggestion.
  • IsUserScoreAction(action string) bool: Identifies user-level score update actions (suggestion).
  • ResolveScoreQuerySid(sl string) string: Resolves id = ? vs slug = ? for score updates based on slim mode.
  • ResolveBlockPostQuerySid(sl string, pw *bool) string: Resolves query column for post blocking based on sl and pw.
  • BuildViewPostModel(id, postID uuid.UUID, userID *uuid.UUID, ipAddress *string) Models.Views: Constructor for Models.Views.
  • BuildSharePostModel(id, userID, postID uuid.UUID) Models.Share: Constructor for Models.Share.
  • BuildScoreUpdateContainerModel(id uuid.UUID, action string, postID, userID *uuid.UUID) Models.ScoreUpdateContainers: Constructor for Models.ScoreUpdateContainers.
  • BuildBlockedPostModel(id, userID, postID uuid.UUID) Models.BlockedPosts: Constructor for Models.BlockedPosts.
  • BuildInsertShareResponse(exist bool, total int64) map[string]interface{}: Formatter for share post responses.
  • BuildInsertViewResponse(exist bool) map[string]interface{}: Formatter for view post responses.
  • BuildUpdateScoreResponse(exist bool) map[string]interface{}: Formatter for score update responses.

2. src/Action/V1/Posts/engagement_helpers_test.go

  • Implemented 13 unit tests covering:
    • TestIsPrivatePost: Validates private, public, unlisted, and nil visibility pointers.
    • TestIsValidIP: Validates IPv4, IPv6, invalid IPs, and empty strings.
    • TestIsValidScoreAction: Validates supported actions and rejects unsupported.
    • TestIsUserScoreAction: Distinguishes user score actions from post score actions.
    • TestResolveScoreQuerySid: Validates query sid resolution for score updates.
    • TestResolveBlockPostQuerySid: Validates query sid resolution for block post.
    • TestBuildViewPostModel: Verifies field mapping on Models.Views.
    • TestBuildSharePostModel: Verifies field mapping on Models.Share.
    • TestBuildScoreUpdateContainerModel: Verifies field mapping on Models.ScoreUpdateContainers.
    • TestBuildBlockedPostModel: Verifies field mapping on Models.BlockedPosts.
    • TestBuildInsertShareResponse: Verifies payload format and counter fields.
    • TestBuildInsertViewResponse: Verifies payload format and exist flag.
    • TestBuildUpdateScoreResponse: Verifies payload format and exist flag.

3. Handlers in src/Action/V1/Posts/

  • InsertViewPost.go:
    • Replaced inline IP parsing with IsValidIP.
    • Replaced inline visibility check with IsPrivatePost.
    • Replaced manual model initialization with BuildViewPostModel.
    • Replaced manual response dictionary with BuildInsertViewResponse.
    • Safe type assertions on Fiber locals (role, encrypt, userId).
  • InsertSharePost.go:
    • Replaced inline visibility check with IsPrivatePost.
    • Replaced manual model initialization with BuildSharePostModel.
    • Replaced response dictionary with BuildInsertShareResponse.
    • Safe type assertions on Fiber locals.
  • UpdateScore.go:
    • Replaced inline action validation with IsValidScoreAction.
    • Replaced inline query resolution with ResolveScoreQuerySid.
    • Replaced model construction with BuildScoreUpdateContainerModel.
    • Replaced response dictionary with BuildUpdateScoreResponse.
    • Safe type assertions on Fiber locals.
  • BlockPost.go:
    • Replaced inline query resolution with ResolveBlockPostQuerySid.
    • Replaced inline visibility check with IsPrivatePost.
    • Replaced model construction with BuildBlockedPostModel.
    • Safe type assertions on Fiber locals.
  • CheckPost.go:
    • Cleaned up parameter checks and safe database result evaluation.

Verification

go test -v ./src/Action/V1/Posts/...
go vet ./src/Action/V1/Posts
go test ./...
  • All 20 unit tests in src/Action/V1/Posts passed.
  • go vet reported zero issues.
  • Entire project test suite across all packages passed cleanly.

Problem

The post engagement and visibility actions in src/Action/V1/Posts/ (InsertViewPost.go, InsertSharePost.go, UpdateScore.go, BlockPost.go, and CheckPost.go) contain repeated patterns and unsafe type assertions:

  1. Unsafe Type Assertions: Multiple context local assertions (c.Locals("role").(string), c.Locals("userId").(string), c.Locals("encrypt").(string)) risk runtime panics if called with missing or malformed claims.
  2. Duplicated Visibility Checks: Repetitive inspection of post visibility pointers against "private" across viewing, sharing, and blocking operations.
  3. Scattered Query Sid Resolutions: Custom query parameter decoding (sl and pw) for resolving database lookups (id = ? vs slug = ?).
  4. Duplicated Response and Model Construction: Repetitive struct initialization for Models.Views, Models.Share, Models.ScoreUpdateContainers, and Models.BlockedPosts.
  5. No Unit Tests for Engagement Actions: Zero unit test coverage for engagement and visibility helper functions.

Scope

  • Create src/Action/V1/Posts/engagement_helpers.go:
    • IsPrivatePost: Checks if post visibility is "private".
    • IsValidIP: Checks if an IP string is valid IPv4 or IPv6.
    • IsValidScoreAction: Validates supported score update actions (view, like, comment, suggestion).
    • IsUserScoreAction: Distinguishes user-level score actions (suggestion) from post-level score actions (view, like, comment).
    • ResolveScoreQuerySid: Resolves query column for score updates based on slim mode.
    • ResolveBlockPostQuerySid: Resolves query column for block post based on slim and pw parameters.
    • BuildViewPostModel: Constructs Models.Views instance.
    • BuildSharePostModel: Constructs Models.Share instance.
    • BuildScoreUpdateContainerModel: Constructs Models.ScoreUpdateContainers instance.
    • BuildBlockedPostModel: Constructs Models.BlockedPosts instance.
    • BuildInsertShareResponse: Formats response for InsertSharePost.
    • BuildInsertViewResponse: Formats response for InsertViewPost.
    • BuildUpdateScoreResponse: Formats response for UpdateScore.
  • Refactor InsertViewPost.go, InsertSharePost.go, UpdateScore.go, BlockPost.go, and CheckPost.go to use engagement_helpers.go with safe type assertions.
  • Add comprehensive unit tests in src/Action/V1/Posts/engagement_helpers_test.go.

Behavior Boundary

  • 100% backward compatible: No changes to endpoint contracts, request payloads, response payloads, status codes, or database schema.

Acceptance Criteria

  • engagement_helpers.go implemented and used across all 5 engagement and visibility handlers.
  • engagement_helpers_test.go implemented and passing with comprehensive coverage.
  • All tests in src/Action/V1/Posts/... pass (go test -v ./src/Action/V1/Posts).
  • go vet ./src/Action/V1/Posts reports zero issues.
  • Entire project test suite passes (go test ./...).

Delivery

Implemented in the working tree on 2026-10-01.

issues.display_title: Issue #527: Refactor Users Module Profile, Feedback, and Onboarding Flows
issues.main_description_html:
Implementation: Refactor Users Module Profile, Feedback, and Onboarding Flows

Summary

Refactored src/Action/V1/Users/ profile, feedback, and onboarding handlers (EditProfile, ContactUs, and SaveOnboarding) by extracting shared field validations into profile_helpers.go and dedicating onboarding_helpers.go to modular onboarding validators and response builders. Added backward-compatible legacy wrappers in SaveOnboarding.go to guarantee zero disruptions to existing test harnesses or callers, while hardening context type assertions across all three handlers.

Files Updated

1. src/Action/V1/Users/profile_helpers.go

  • ValidateProfileUsername(username string) (string, string, bool): Validates username length (5-30), regex characters, and non-numeric rule with exact error messages and field code.
  • ValidateProfileFullname(fullname string) (string, string, bool): Validates fullname length (3-50) and disallowed special characters.
  • ValidateProfileAboutMe(aboutMe string, maxRunes int) (string, bool): Validates rune limit (default 2200) and returns HTML-escaped string.
  • ValidateProfileGender(gender string) bool: Checks gender against Patterns.GenderSpecialChars.
  • ValidateProfileEmailInfo(emailInfo string) bool: Checks email info against Patterns.EmailSpecialCharsNoSpace.
  • BuildProfileUpdates(...) map[string]interface{}: Prepares the dictionary of profile fields and optional avatar/path updates with updated_at.
  • NormalizeContactSubject(value string) (string, bool): Normalizes contact subjects (Feature Request, Performance, Software/Hardware Compatibility, Other).
  • NormalizeContactPlatform(value string) (string, bool): Normalizes client platform codes (Panorra Web, Panorra Mobile).
  • BuildContactEmailPayload(...) map[string]interface{}: Formats RabbitMQ support contact email queue message.

2. src/Action/V1/Users/onboarding_helpers.go

  • ValidateDiscoverySource(value string) bool: Whitelist validation for discovery sources.
  • ValidatePlaceInterests(values []string) ([]string, bool): Validates place interests and deduplicates values.
  • ValidateUsageIntent(value string) bool: Whitelist validation for usage intents.
  • IsOnboardingComplete(hasSource, hasInterests, hasIntent bool) bool: Validates whether all 3 required onboarding categories are fulfilled.
  • HasStoredPlaceInterests(raw json.RawMessage) bool: Validates non-empty stored place interest JSON.
  • HasOnboardingInput(completed *bool, updateCount int) bool: Checks presence of onboarding inputs.
  • BuildOnboardingResponse(saved Models.UserDetail) fiber.Map: Formats standardized response for SaveOnboarding.

3. Unit Tests Added

  • profile_helpers_test.go:
    • TestValidateProfileUsername: Tests valid, short, long, special char, and numeric usernames.
    • TestValidateProfileFullname: Tests valid, short, long, and special char fullnames.
    • TestValidateProfileAboutMe: Tests rune count validation and HTML escaping.
    • TestValidateProfileGender: Tests valid genders and special character rejection.
    • TestValidateProfileEmailInfo: Tests valid and invalid email info strings.
    • TestBuildProfileUpdates: Tests field mapping with and without avatar.
    • TestNormalizeContactSubject: Tests all supported subjects and invalid fallback.
    • TestNormalizeContactPlatform: Tests empty, pm, pw, case insensitivity, and invalid fallback.
    • TestBuildContactEmailPayload: Tests message payload structure and fields.
  • onboarding_helpers_test.go:
    • TestValidateDiscoverySourceExported: Validates all sources and invalid rejections.
    • TestValidatePlaceInterestsExported: Tests valid values, duplicate stripping, empty list, and unknown interest rejection.
    • TestValidateUsageIntentExported: Tests all valid intents and invalid intent.
    • TestIsOnboardingCompleteExported: Tests all permutations of source, interest, and intent boolean flags.
    • TestHasStoredPlaceInterestsExported: Tests non-empty, empty array, null, and malformed JSON.
    • TestHasOnboardingInputExported: Tests completed flag presence, update count presence, and neither.
    • TestBuildOnboardingResponseExported: Tests full response structure and field mapping.
  • SaveOnboarding_test.go: Existing test suite maintained with 100% pass rate.

4. Handlers in src/Action/V1/Users/

  • EditProfile.go:
    • Replaced inline username validations with ValidateProfileUsername.
    • Replaced inline fullname validations with ValidateProfileFullname.
    • Replaced inline about-me validations with ValidateProfileAboutMe.
    • Replaced inline gender validation with ValidateProfileGender.
    • Replaced inline email-info validation with ValidateProfileEmailInfo.
    • Replaced manual update map building with BuildProfileUpdates.
    • Added safe type assertions on Fiber context locals (role, encrypt).
  • ContactUs.go:
    • Replaced inline subject normalization with NormalizeContactSubject.
    • Replaced inline platform normalization with NormalizeContactPlatform.
    • Replaced inline email queue message building with BuildContactEmailPayload.
    • Added safe type assertions on user data and locals.
  • SaveOnboarding.go:
    • Preserved legacy wrappers (validateDiscoverySource, validatePlaceInterests, validateUsageIntent, onboardingComplete, hasStoredPlaceInterests, hasOnboardingInput) mapping directly to the new modular helpers.
    • Replaced response map assembly with BuildOnboardingResponse.
    • Added safe type assertions on context locals (role, userId, encrypt, last_login).

Verification

go test -v ./src/Action/V1/Users/...
go vet ./src/Action/V1/Users
go test ./...
  • All 35 unit tests in src/Action/V1/Users passed.
  • go vet reported zero issues.
  • Entire project test suite across all packages passed cleanly.

Problem

The profile, feedback, and onboarding actions in src/Action/V1/Users/ (EditProfile.go, ContactUs.go, and SaveOnboarding.go) accumulated complex procedural logic with repetitive validations and unsafe type assertions:

  1. Unsafe Type Assertions: Direct casting on context locals (role, encrypt, userId, last_login) without checks, risking panics on malformed contexts.
  2. Scattered Profile Validations: Username constraints (min 5, max 30, pattern, no all-digits), fullname constraints (min 3, max 50, special characters), about me rune counts, gender patterns, and email info patterns were written inline in a 376-line handler.
  3. Inline Contact Submitter & Subject Logic: Contact Us subject/platform normalizers and email queue payloads were defined inside the handler file without standalone unit test coverage.
  4. Onboarding Hardening: SaveOnboarding.go contains heavily utilized validation logic for discovery sources, deduplicated place interests, and usage intents that required dedicated modular helpers and backward-compatible wrappers to guarantee zero regressions.

Scope

  • Create src/Action/V1/Users/profile_helpers.go:
    • ValidateProfileUsername: Validates username length, character pattern, and non-numeric rule.
    • ValidateProfileFullname: Validates full name length and allowed characters.
    • ValidateProfileAboutMe: Validates length constraint and returns HTML-escaped string.
    • ValidateProfileGender: Validates gender input against special characters.
    • ValidateProfileEmailInfo: Validates email info format.
    • BuildProfileUpdates: Generates database update map for profile fields.
    • NormalizeContactSubject: Maps contact us subjects to standard titles.
    • NormalizeContactPlatform: Normalizes client platform codes (pm, pw).
    • BuildContactEmailPayload: Generates RabbitMQ queue payload for support notifications.
  • Create src/Action/V1/Users/onboarding_helpers.go:
    • ValidateDiscoverySource: Validates discovery source against whitelist.
    • ValidatePlaceInterests: Validates place interests and deduplicates entries.
    • ValidateUsageIntent: Validates usage intent against whitelist.
    • IsOnboardingComplete: Verifies whether source, interests, and intent requirements are met.
    • HasStoredPlaceInterests: Verifies non-empty stored place interest JSON.
    • HasOnboardingInput: Verifies presence of onboarding inputs.
    • BuildOnboardingResponse: Formats standardized response for SaveOnboarding.
  • Refactor EditProfile.go, ContactUs.go, and SaveOnboarding.go with safe type assertions and backward-compatible wrappers.
  • Add comprehensive unit tests in profile_helpers_test.go and onboarding_helpers_test.go.

Behavior Boundary

  • 100% backward compatible: No changes to endpoint URLs, form field names, validation error messages/codes, JSON responses, or database updates. All legacy function names (validateDiscoverySource, validatePlaceInterests, validateUsageIntent, onboardingComplete, hasStoredPlaceInterests, hasOnboardingInput) remain available.

Acceptance Criteria

  • profile_helpers.go and onboarding_helpers.go implemented and integrated.
  • profile_helpers_test.go, onboarding_helpers_test.go, and existing SaveOnboarding_test.go all pass.
  • All tests in src/Action/V1/Users/... pass (go test -v ./src/Action/V1/Users).
  • go vet ./src/Action/V1/Users reports zero issues.
  • Entire project test suite passes cleanly (go test ./...).

Delivery

Implemented in the working tree on 2026-10-01.
